decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted Design and Access Statement, A493/M01, Slimlite Double Glazed Specifications, Slimlite Double Glazed Units, Received 27 September 2011, A493/01A, Received 21 November 2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Replacement of existing double glazed french doors, fanlights and side panels to rear outrigger and conservatory with new timber framed sliding folding doors and fanlights, replacement of existing windows to rear outrigger with new double glazed windows and construction of timber framed bicycle shed to front garden
